extracted.name: Grandma's Slow Cooker Swiss Steak
extracted.description: Swiss steak strips cooked low and slow in the crockpot for hours, making a delicious brown gravy. Great served over mashed potatoes or egg noodles.
ingredient_lines: 2 pounds beef round steak, cut into strips
1 (14.5 ounce) can cream of mushroom soup
1 tablespoon chopped green bell pepper, or more to taste
0.5 teaspoon browning sauce (such as Kitchen Bouquet®), or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Place flour into a bowl. Dredge round steak strips in flour to coat.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat; brown strips of round steak in the hot oil, 7 to 8 minutes per side.

Transfer beef strips to a slow cooker. Add cream of mushroom soup, Cheddar cheese soup, onion, green bell pepper, garlic, Worcestershire sauce, and browning sauce; stir. Season mixture with salt and black pepper.
Cook on High and cook for 4 hours.
